# Assets · Logos

6 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for estoq-wordmark-charcoal.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The estoq wordmark and Q mark, each as a transparent PNG in one solid ink. The ink is in the file name: `charcoal` (#17191C) for `ivory` or white grounds, `gold` (#D6B77A) and `ivory` (#F1EFE9) for `charcoal` grounds.

- `estoq-wordmark-*.png` — sidebar header, splash, login, reports, website. Minimum width 72px on screen.
- `estoq-q-mark-*.png` — Windows app icon, favicon, avatar-size placements. Minimum 24px.
- Clear space around either mark: at least the height of the wordmark's "o".
